summary: Clarify SourceDAO deployment phases and show the latest USDB block hash
details: Separate unstarted, starting, deploying, finalizing, incomplete and on-chain finalized SourceDAO phases from the latest local task outcome, with explicit unknown observations.

Show pending transaction names, nonces and hashes plus recorded receipt progress through a whitelist that excludes signed transaction bytes. Journal counts do not replace canonical receipt validation.
Refresh SourceDAO watch in a terminal panel, preserve the final observation, and separate plain output frames with timestamps while printing long paths only at the boundaries.
Read the latest chain height and hash from one block response and show the hash on its own progress line, including same-height head changes.
Document the existing sequential 22-transaction bootstrap ceremony and its receipt waits; transaction submission and recovery rules remain unchanged.
operator_actions: Use the updated node kit and reopen sourcedao check/status or node status --watch to see detailed observations. Running deployments can continue with their original tools image.
